noProjectBody: Select or create a project in the sidebar to get started.
malformedRowsHelp: These rows had a quote immediately followed by a comma (e.g. JSON or quoted text inside a cell), which mis-splits the columns in the game CSV format. They were dropped to avoid writing column-shifted data. Fix the affected cells in the source CSV and re-import.
importSnapshotNote: A safety snapshot was taken just before this import ({{date}}). You can restore it from the Backup tab.
activatedLanguages: Activated languages found in the file: {{languages}}
duplicateLanguageHeaders: These language columns appeared more than once and were merged: {{headers}}
rawNewlineLanguagesNotice: Raw line breaks found in: {{languages}}. Consider removing them or replacing them with the \n marker.
importModeAddOnlyHint: Existing entries missing from this file are kept untouched.
importModeFullReplaceHint: Entries missing from this file are marked orphaned (excluded from AI runs until relinked or deleted).
fullReplacePreviewLoading: Checking how many entries this would orphan…
fullReplaceOrphanNotice: {{count}} existing entries are missing from this file and will be marked orphaned — resolve them later in the Relink tab.
importSheetDescription: Choose how this file is applied to the project.
importWarningsDescription: This file has a few things worth checking before you import it:
unknownHeadersDescription: The following column headers were not recognized and will be ignored during import:
rawNewlineLanguagesDescription: These languages have a cell containing an actual line break instead of the literal \n marker. This can cause unexpected behavior in-game — consider removing the line break, or replacing it with \n if you want an in-game line break:
discardUntranslatable: Discard entries that don't need translation
exportLanguagesHint: Which columns to include in this export
pseudoExportHint: Fills the chosen language's column with the Pseudo Test text in the exported file only — stored translations are untouched.
exportRoundtripWarning: Export done, but {{count}} cell may not re-import cleanly (a quote followed by a comma or line break in: {{columns}}). Fix those cells before re-importing.
exportRoundtripWarning_plural: Export done, but {{count}} cells may not re-import cleanly (a quote followed by a comma or line break in: {{columns}}). Fix those cells before re-importing.
confirmDeleteDescription: This will permanently delete "{{name}}" and all its entries. This cannot be undone.
globalConfigDescription: Workspace-wide module defaults. Projects can inherit from or override these values.
workspaceSettingsDescription: Global settings that apply to the entire workspace.
maxBackupsDescription: How many backups to keep per project before the oldest are pruned. Leave blank to use the default (10).
structuredOutputExperimentalWarning: Enabling structured output should improve format consistency and reduce retries, though the feature is still experimental. Try it both on and off with the model you use, and keep whichever gives better results.
structuredOutputLunaWarning: gpt-5.6-luna frequently refuses to translate (returning an error or malformed reply instead of a translation) when structured output is enabled. If you see failures with this model, try disabling structured output or switching to a different model.
enableModuleHelp: Add an AI or translation provider to use across your projects.

routing.title: Routing Rules
routing.noRules: No routing rules. Add one to begin.
routing.sourcesHint: Source labels appear here once entries are imported.
routing.maxLengthHelp: Apply this rule only when the entry length is less than or equal to this limit.
routing.tonesHint: Tones are set per entry in the Compare tab.
routing.defaultToneHelp: Used for entries this rule translates that have no tone of their own.
routing.deletedInstanceWarning: This rule references a deleted module instance.
routing.groupSwitchLocked: Group switching is locked while translations are running.
routing.categoriesConfiguredHint: Categories are configured in the Multi-Language Text tab.
routing.templateMeta: · all content types · max {{maxLength}} chars · all languages
routing.importExportHint: Import or export routing rules as a JSON file.
routing.importFailed: Failed to import: invalid routing rules file.
routing.groupSwitchInProgress: Cannot switch rule groups while translations are in progress.

overflowRatioDescription: Default overflow ratio applied to newly imported entries. Used at LQA gate to detect text overflow. Default: 1.75.
requestsPerSecondDescription: Global client-side rate limit applied to every network-bound translation module (per outbound request). 0 = disabled.
requestTimeoutDescription: Maximum time to wait for a single AI provider call (translate, judge, source review, glossary, category) before it is treated as a transient error and retried at a smaller batch size. Default: 300 (5 minutes).
maxOutputTokensDescription: Per-request output-token cap applied to every AI provider call (translate, judge, source review, glossary, category). Bounds the response a misconfigured provider can stream back. 0 = unlimited (each provider applies its own maximum). Default: 0.
batchGroupingDescription: Keep related entries in the same batch across translation, judge and source-review runs, so the model sees them together. Glossary-term and category generation are unaffected.
ignoreBatchSizeLimitDescription: Send each related-entry group as one batch regardless of the size cap. Larger requests can be slower or hit provider limits; a rate-limited oversized batch is retried whole once, then split into smaller batches — leave off unless you know the group fits.
credentialsVaultLocked: Vault is locked — unlock it to use this module's credentials.

models.pricingNote: Translations call each provider's API directly with your own keys. Prices are sourced from each provider's own official pricing page, so they are estimates.
models.searchOrType: Search or type a model name…

confidenceReason.batch-exceeds-reliable: {{entryCount}} entries exceeds the ~{{reliable}} this model handles reliably in one run
confidenceReason.prompt-near-context: The prompt (~{{tokens}} tokens) approaches the usable context window (~{{context}} tokens)
confidenceReason.prompt-exceeds-context: The prompt (~{{tokens}} tokens) exceeds the usable context window (~{{context}} tokens)

models.footprintHint: Measure each model's loaded VRAM at its configured context

instances.slugHelp: Any value works — it's just a label so you can tell this instance apart from your other {{base}} ones. It can't be changed after the instance is created.
instances.slugReserved: “{{slug}}” is a reserved module id — choose a different slug.

lqa.title: LQA Checks
lqa.description: Quality checks run on every translation. Blocking issues fail the gate and can trigger an automatic retry; warnings are reported only.
lqa.lengthLimitNote: Hard limits imposed by the game editor (not configurable). Translations exceeding either bound are flagged.

tag-equality.name: Inline tag equality
tag-equality.description: Inline markup tags must match between source and translation.

overflow.name: Length overflow
overflow.description: Flags translations longer than the entry's overflow ratio.

length-limit.name: Length limit
length-limit.description: Flags translations that exceed the per-language character or UTF-8 byte limits of the game editor.

glossary-adherence.name: Glossary adherence
glossary-adherence.description: Glossary terms matched in the source must appear translated in the output (whole-word match). At warning severity the issue is informational only; set severity to blocking to trigger the automatic retry.

forbidden-terms.name: Forbidden terms
forbidden-terms.description: Flags configured forbidden terms, per language or for all languages.

regex-assertions.name: Regex assertions
regex-assertions.description: User-defined patterns the translation must match or must not match.

mask-integrity.name: Mask integrity
mask-integrity.description: Masked placeholders must survive the round-trip through the translation backend.

number-parity.name: Number parity
number-parity.description: Flags numerals present in the source but missing from the translation (and vice versa); tolerant of decimal-separator localization.

whitespace-parity.name: Whitespace parity
whitespace-parity.description: Flags leading/trailing whitespace that differs from the source.

line-break-parity.name: Line-break parity
line-break-parity.description: Flags translations whose literal \n escapes or real line breaks differ from the source — broken line breaks render wrong in-game.

end-punctuation.name: End punctuation
end-punctuation.description: Flags terminal punctuation that differs from the source, with per-language equivalents (e.g. CJK fullwidth marks).

double-spacing.name: Double spacing
double-spacing.description: Flags repeated spaces in the translation that the source does not have.

double-words.name: Double words
double-words.description: Flags accidentally repeated words ("the the") in the translation.

untranslated.name: Untranslated
untranslated.description: Flags translations identical to the source text (entries trivial matchers would catch are skipped).

achievement-length-limit.name: Achievement length limit
achievement-length-limit.description: Flags achievement name/description translations exceeding their UTF-8 byte limits. Applies to entries tagged as an achievement name or description; warning only by default.

tm.policyDescription: Controls when previously stored translations are reused automatically for identical source text.
tm.policyUpdateFailed: Failed to update translation memory policy: {{message}}
tm.browserDescription: Stored translations reused across projects. Variants are grouped by source text.
tm.browserEmpty: No translation memory entries yet. Entries are stored when you approve a translation.
tm.searchPlaceholder: Search source, translation, language or module…
tm.searchEmpty: No translation memory entries match your search.
tm.clearAllHint: Permanently delete all translation memory across every project? This cannot be undone.

saveAsTemplateDescription: Save this project's languages, routing rules, module settings and glossary selections as a reusable template.
templatesDescription: Reusable project configuration snapshots. Pick one when creating a new project in the sidebar.
